summary: Client only. Invisible solid boxes in this game only, as an editor's author uses to keep players off a cliff edge, close a gap with a floor or lay a ramp up to a door. A box blocks players, horses and anything else the game's physics moves, and nothing draws it. The server does not know about it, and no other player has it. A resource's boxes are taken away when it stops or the world goes. World Architect's Collision mode is built on it.

addBox.summary: Adds a solid invisible box and returns it. The box has `id`, `valid`, `center`, `size` and `rotation`, and two methods: `set({ center, size, rotation })` moves, sizes or turns it in one go, leaving out what is undefined; `remove()` takes it away and is safe to repeat. Throws a TypeError for a missing center or size, a RangeError for a side outside 0.02 to 200 metres, a centre out of the world, or more than 1024 boxes in this game.

params.box: { center, size, rotation }: its middle (Vector3); its width, depth and height in metres along its own axes (Vector3); and optionally its turn, a quaternion or angles in degrees { x, y, z }, none by default.

addBox.returns: { readonly id: number; readonly valid: boolean; readonly center: Vector3; readonly size: Vector3; readonly rotation: Quaternion; set(pose: { center?: Vector3; size?: Vector3; rotation?: { x: number; y: number; z: number; w?: number } }): void; remove(): void }
addBox.exampleLua:
-- client
local Collision = kcds.world.Collision
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local wall = Collision.addBox({ center = Vector3.new(1533, 2143, 17.1), size = Vector3.new(6, 0.3, 3), rotation = { x = 0, y = 0, z = 30 } })
wall:set({ size = Vector3.new(8, 0.3, 3) })
wall:remove()

all.summary: Your resource's boxes that still stand.
all.returns: Array<{ readonly id: number; readonly center: Vector3; readonly size: Vector3; remove(): void }>
all.exampleLua:
-- client
for _, box in ipairs(kcds.world.Collision.all()) do
  box:remove()
end
